ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: The figure below shows changes in land-use types and urban air quality (pm10 refers to inhalable particulate matter in the air with a diameter less than 10 micrometers) in a certain city of China. <image1> According to the diagram, which type of land-use area in this city changed very little?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: On the left side of the figure is a bar chart of land-use type proportions for the three years 1975, 1990, and 2005; the legend includes forest land, grassland, residential land, road and square land, and other; on the right side there is also a line graph of monthly average pm10 concentration. Observing the bars for each year according to the legend, the bar heights of forest land, residential land, other and other types change relatively noticeably, while the bars corresponding to "road and square land" are similar in height in the three years 1975, 1990, and 2005, and the range of change is very small. Then reason: The question asks which type of land-use area changed very little; comparing changes in the area of each type of land use, one should choose "road and square land," whose bar height fluctuates the least.

method.method_draft: 先读图：这是按1975、1990、2005三组年份绘制的土地利用类型柱状图，右侧图例给出各柱形纹理对应的土地类型。根据图例找到“道路与广场用地”对应的柱形纹理，再分别读取三个年份中该类柱子的高度，发现三年数值都在较接近的范围内，起伏明显小于林地、居民用地、其他等类型。结合题干询问“哪类土地利用面积变化很小”，据此回答道路与广场用地。
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中左侧是1975、1990、2005三个年份的土地利用类型比例柱状图，图例包括林地、草地、居民用地、道路与广场用地、其它；右侧还有pm10浓度月平均值折线。根据图例观察各年份柱形，林地、居民用地、其它等类型的柱高变化较明显，而“道路与广场用地”对应的柱形在1975、1990、2005三个年份中高度相近，变化幅度很小。
再推理：题目问哪类土地利用面积变化很小，对比各类土地利用面积变化，应选柱高起伏最小的“道路与广场用地”。
